variants.name: default
variants.description: SDL_shadercross at the commit vcpkg's port pins (it has no release tags), from the Automap registry's port, built without DXC on every platform: it compiles SPIR-V to DXBC (through the system's d3dcompiler_47.dll on Windows), MSL and SPIR-V, and reflects it, so a game that hands it SPIR-V ships nothing extra. It takes no HLSL source and makes no DXIL at run time; the port's dxc feature links DXC in for that, and a program built with it ships dxcompiler and dxil. Where vcpkg has DXC (Windows, x64 Linux), the port still installs it as a tool, which the build fragment's automap_compile_shaders() uses to compile HLSL to SPIR-V when the game builds.

assets.file_io_hook: every function takes SPIR-V as bytes; it reads no file itself
output_settings: SDL_SHADERCROSS_PROP_* properties, such as the MSL version

build-flags.consumer_flags: SDL_shadercross allocates with SDL_malloc, so SDL3's allocation binding routes it; it links SPIRV-Cross statically and loads d3dcompiler_47.dll at runtime on Windows for DXBC. This build links no DXC: SDL_SHADERCROSS_DXC is not defined, and the functions that take HLSL or make DXIL fail with an error.
